name: Kokonotsu
source:
A student at Central High School and Roku's twin brother.

Soft demeanor and gentle to everyone. He has a princely temperament and is very popular.

However, when he gets angry, he seems to be more dangerous than Roku.

"I'll help you too. Let's do our best together."

[Translated from [url=https://mo-623-mo.amebaownd.com/posts/22703015]official website[/url]]
